factProposals.value: A performance report gives availability overall and per component, median and 95th percentile response time, incidents, and help desk volume, service level and time to resolve.

decisions.statement: A report is refused, not estimated, when its period has no monitoring samples.
decisions.rationale: Trust: no number the project has not produced.

decisions.statement: Archived reports are append-only and carry the SHA-256 of their body.
decisions.rationale: A later copy can be checked against the archive.

limitations.statement: Report periods are whole days in UTC, and reports are generated on request rather than on a schedule.
